improvements: When preparing potion tests, the bot now stays with the testing spot chosen for its stored potions instead of switching to preferred water. It checks that the spot still protects the potions before proceeding.

Revalidate current bank safety and potion protection before testing; retain mandatory pickup, honest receipts and explicit planner exhaustion.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health when the planner exhausted its options. Decision 70 (log line 194) exposed a sentry and Chest 968 at entrance 941, but preparation required complete room geometry that the public observations did not provide. Exploration withdrew, while the missing haste supply remained reserved. At decision 228 (lines 651–653), that reservation blocked mandatory potion discovery and descent; no recovery action was accepted. Offline bookkeeping reconstruction from the played source matches all 228 earlier selections and reproduces this blocker. The chest later disappeared from the object list without a collection receipt; it must not be credited as collected. No patch is supplied: ordinary entrance-floor routes exist, but no validated reconnaissance transaction establishes the missing perimeter, fresh potion-safe bank/storage and reward round trip. Terminal inventory contains neither known haste nor an executable identification or mapping resource. Source browsing resolves the selecting-chain gap, not these safety prerequisites. The unchanged Python suite passes 2075 tests, with four skipped; no new regression or red/green repair result is claimed.
review.learnings: Incomplete sentry geometry needs an explicit preparation-only reconnaissance prerequisite, not indefinite supply reservation. Validate ordinary-floor reobservation and door closure before selecting a return; require fresh geometry, potion protection, actual effects and collection receipts before testing or retrieving rewards. Never assign effects to unknown colors or replace planner exhaustion with idle waits.

Next derive paired decision-70/228 fixtures for entrance 941 and ordinary floor 964–966, validate a bounded preparation-only reobservation transaction against door closure and public sight rules, and require accepted movement and fresh observations before existing bank, stash and journey checks. Complete selecting source and matching reconstruction resolve the packet’s memory gap, but not these replacement-action safety requirements.
